newsitem.title: USA: Glatfelter says low selling prices hurt Q2.
newsitem.headline: Glatfelter says low selling prices hurt Q2.

text.p: P.H. Glatfelter Co said Wednesday that significantly lower selling prices for printing papers was the primary reason for its lower net income for the second quarter and the first half.
Glatfelter, which produces printing papers and other specialty papers, noted, however, that prices for those papers stabilized during the second quarter.
It said it had implemented a modest price increase for commodity printing papers midway through the quarter, and a second price increase has been announced, effective August 1.
It said stronger industry-wide demand for uncoated papers and a firming of the pulp market are key factors driving the recent paper price increases.
It said it is hopeful that price increases for book publishing papers, a major product line of the company, can be implemented later in the year.
